hooks.text: 被困在封印混沌与怪物先知King Mokdu追随者的诅咒棺匣中，每轮都更深陷入记忆、苦难与轮回
hooks.excerpt: You are trapped within the Casket — a cursed device forged to imprison the will of chaos and those who follow the monstrous prophet, King Mokdu. Every run drives you deeper into a cycle of memory, suffering, and rebirth, handing you new weapons and corrupted artifacts to engrave and master.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 武器觉醒、传奇刻印与可叠加遗物共同塑造每轮构筑
hooks.excerpt: Weapons — bound to Wardens of Ordeal, they define your combat identity and unlock powerful Awakening and Final Awakening skills. Legendary Artifacts (30) — corrupted relics whose abilities you unlock by spending Echoes to Engrave them, working toward a full Revelation: the central pursuit of every run. Common Artifacts (60+) — stack and duplicate to reinforce and mutate your stats.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 普通敌人可被连击压制，但Fiend完全不会硬直，必须读懂攻击节奏并用Counter Spell精准招架制造破绽
hooks.excerpt: Most stagger under your blows, so you press forward and carve through them — but Fiends never flinch. To break one you must read its rhythm and answer with a Counter Spell, a clean parry that turns its assault into your opening.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
